profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack · Machine Learning · Data Science
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer based in Wichita, KS with a passion for building software that actually makes a difference.
 
My work spans enterprise web applications, backend systems, and integrating computer vision and machine learning into real manufacturing environments. I enjoy tackling complex problems and turning them into clean, reliable solutions that people depend on every day.
 
Outside of engineering I collaborate with medical researchers, applying data science and machine learning to support peer-reviewed publications, bridging the gap between software and science.
 
Always open to interesting problems and new connections.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Co-led development of PATH, an enterprise web application that modernized material traceability, machine scheduling, and quality control workflows by replacing a legacy Access database. Architected the backend using .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, and Blazor, writing recursive SQL queries for deep material genealogy tracking, engineering ACID-compliant transactions, and building a defect reporting system with automated maintenance scheduling. Also designed frontend workflows using Handsontable and JS Interop for high-volume data entry directly in the browser. Also architected MARS, a modular desktop tool suite that automates engineering test data reduction across multiple pluggable analysis modules, eliminating hours of manual Excel work per test cycle.

positions.title: Research Development Software Engineer
positions.description: Served a dual role at NIAR's ATLAS lab contributing to both software development and research simultaneously. On the software side, developed and maintained C# / .NET components for an AFP manufacturing system, integrated an ML-based defect detection system with real-time accuracy metrics, and built an OpenCV monitoring system for an injection molding machine tracking depth, temperature, and alignment in real time. On the R&D side, operated and maintained complex manufacturing machinery, analyzed composite materials for quality assurance, used CATIA for precision part design, and mentored junior team members.
positions.insights: Data Analysis, Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) and +8 skills

positions.title: International Sales Representative
positions.description: Represented MetaPet at CES 2025 as an International Sales Representative, showcasing an AI-powered plush companion toy to a global audience. Delivered live product demonstrations highlighting emotion detection, adaptive AI learning, and wireless charging, working directly with potential buyers and partners to drive interest and expand MetaPet's reach in the AI companion market.
